ex.en: The yearly fee is 1,200 dollars.
ex.zh: 年費是 1,200 美元。

ex.en: We have a yearly performance review.
ex.zh: 我們每年有一次績效考核。

yearly.en: happening or done once every twelve months

ex.en: The festival is held yearly in October.
ex.zh: 這個節慶每年十月舉辦。

ex.en: Prices are updated yearly.
ex.zh: 價格每年更新一次。

ex.en: Each member has to pay 10,000 yen a month.
ex.zh: 每位會員每個月要付一萬日圓。

ex.en: A cup of coffee cost 200 yen in those days.
ex.zh: 那時候一杯咖啡要兩百日圓。

ex.en: It cost me 5,000 yen to repair my bicycle.
ex.zh: 修腳踏車花了我五千日圓。

ex.en: The price is double what it was last year.
ex.zh: 這個價格是去年的兩倍。

ex.en: We've been having strange weather the past few years.
ex.zh: 這幾年的天氣一直很反常。

ex.en: The new school year starts in September.
ex.zh: 新學年從九月開始。

ex.en: The company's financial year ends in March.
ex.zh: 這家公司的會計年度在三月結束。

year.en: a period of twelve months used for school or business

ex.en: My daughter is five years old.
ex.zh: 我女兒五歲。

ex.en: He is two years younger than his wife.
ex.zh: 他比他太太小兩歲。

year.en: a unit used to say how old a person or thing is

ex.en: "Is he going to swim tomorrow?" "Yes, he is."
ex.zh: 「他明天會去游泳嗎？」「是的，他會。」

ex.en: "Did he write a letter yesterday?" "Yes, he did."
ex.zh: 「他昨天寫信了嗎？」「是的，他寫了。」

ex.en: "Are you friends with Mary?" "Yes, she's my roommate."
ex.zh: 「你和瑪麗是朋友嗎？」「是啊，她是我室友。」

yes.en: used to give a positive answer or to agree

ex.en: She said yes to my proposal.
ex.zh: 她答應了我的提議。

ex.en: We need a yes or no by Friday.
ex.zh: 我們需要你在星期五前給個明確答覆。

yes.en: an answer that shows you agree or accept

ex.en: Jiro has not come back from New York yet.
ex.zh: 次郎還沒從紐約回來。

ex.en: He hasn't yet turned in the report this month.
ex.zh: 他這個月的報告還沒交。

ex.en: He looks old, but he hasn't reached 30 yet.
ex.zh: 他看起來老，但其實還不到三十歲。

yet.en: up to now, used to say that something has not happened but may happen

ex.en: Have you got used to eating Japanese food yet?
ex.zh: 你習慣吃日本料理了嗎？

ex.en: Have you finished the report yet?
ex.zh: 你報告寫完了嗎？

yet.en: used to ask whether something has happened by now

ex.en: He is rich yet he lives like a beggar.
ex.zh: 他很有錢，卻過得像乞丐。

ex.en: And yet, the contrary is always true as well.
ex.zh: 然而，反過來說也總是成立。

yet.en: used to add a surprising or opposite fact

ex.en: You ought to have come to see me yesterday.
ex.zh: 你昨天應該來看我的。

ex.en: This is the same pen that I lost yesterday.
ex.zh: 這支筆跟我昨天弄丟的是同一支。

ex.en: I slept all day yesterday, because it was Sunday.
ex.zh: 昨天是星期天，所以我睡了一整天。

ex.en: Yesterday was my birthday.
ex.zh: 昨天是我的生日。

ex.en: Did you read yesterday's newspaper?
ex.zh: 你看了昨天的報紙嗎？

ex.en: "Does it taste good?" "Yeah, it's good."
ex.zh: 「好吃嗎？」「嗯，很好吃。」

ex.en: Yeah. I think so, too.
ex.zh: 對，我也這麼覺得。

ex.en: Oh yeah, I remember that.
ex.zh: 喔對，我記得那件事。

yeah.en: a casual way of saying yes

ex.en: The girl wore a yellow ribbon in her hair.
ex.zh: 那個女孩頭髮上綁著黃色的緞帶。

ex.en: My mother bought my little brother a yellow umbrella.
ex.zh: 我媽媽買了一把黃色的雨傘給我弟弟。

ex.en: These green leaves turn red or yellow in fall.
ex.zh: 這些綠葉到了秋天會變成紅色或黃色。

yellow.en: having the color of a lemon or the middle of an egg

ex.en: Yellow is my favorite color.
ex.zh: 黃色是我最喜歡的顏色。

ex.en: The walls were painted a bright yellow.
ex.zh: 牆壁漆成了亮黃色。

yellow.en: the color of a lemon or the middle of an egg

ex.en: Bread is made from flour, water, and often yeast.
ex.zh: 麵包是用麵粉、水做的，通常還會加酵母。

ex.en: Add the yeast and let the dough rise for an hour.
ex.zh: 加入酵母，讓麵團發酵一小時。

yeast.en: a tiny living thing used to make bread rise and to make beer and wine

ex.en: Nothing can keep me from yearning for freedom.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼可以阻擋，我對自由的嚮往。

ex.en: I yearn for the university.
ex.zh: 我渴望上大學。

ex.en: After years abroad, he yearned for his hometown.
ex.zh: 在國外多年後，他很思念故鄉。

yearn.en: to want something very much, especially something you cannot have now

ex.en: Don't yell at me; I can hear you.
ex.zh: 不要對我大吼，我聽得到。

ex.en: The coach yelled instructions across the field.
ex.zh: 教練隔著球場大聲喊出指示。

ex.en: She yelled for help when she saw the smoke.
ex.zh: 她看到煙時大聲呼救。

ex.en: We heard a loud yell from the next room.
ex.zh: 我們聽到隔壁房間傳來一聲大喊。

ex.en: The crowd let out a yell when the team scored.
ex.zh: 球隊得分時，群眾發出一陣歡呼。

ex.en: "Are you ready to go?" "Yep, let's leave."
ex.zh: 「你準備好要走了嗎？」「嗯，我們出發吧。」

ex.en: Yep, I finished all my homework already.
ex.zh: 對啊，我已經寫完所有功課了。

yeltsin.zh: 葉爾欽（俄羅斯首任總統）

ex.en: Boris Yeltsin was the first president of the Russian Federation.
ex.zh: 鮑里斯·葉爾欽是俄羅斯聯邦的首任總統。

ex.en: Yeltsin took office in 1991 after the Soviet Union ended.
ex.zh: 蘇聯解體後，葉爾欽於 1991 年就任。

ex.en: He felt a deep yearning for home.
ex.zh: 他深深渴望回家。

ex.en: Her yearning to travel grew stronger every year.
ex.zh: 她想旅行的渴望一年比一年強烈。

ex.en: She gave the cake a yearning look.
ex.zh: 她用渴望的眼神看著那塊蛋糕。

ex.en: The yearning child watched the other kids play outside.
ex.zh: 那個滿心嚮往的孩子看著其他小朋友在外面玩。

ex.en: An old yew tree stood in the corner of the churchyard.
ex.zh: 教堂墓園的角落有一棵老紫杉。

ex.en: The garden was surrounded by a neat yew hedge.
ex.zh: 花園四周圍著整齊的紫杉樹籬。

ex.en: Yemen is a country in the southwest of the Arabian Peninsula.
ex.zh: 葉門是位於阿拉伯半島西南部的國家。

ex.en: Yemen is famous for its old mountain towns and coffee.
ex.zh: 葉門以古老的山城和咖啡聞名。

ex.en: I found my old yearbook in a box in the attic.
ex.zh: 我在閣樓的箱子裡找到了我以前的畢業紀念冊。

ex.en: Everyone signed my yearbook on the last day of school.
ex.zh: 最後一天上學時，大家都在我的畢業紀念冊上簽名。

ex.en: The statistics office publishes a yearbook every December.
ex.zh: 統計單位每年十二月出版一本年鑑。

ex.en: You can find the population numbers in the city's yearbook.
ex.zh: 你可以在這座城市的年鑑裡查到人口數字。

ex.en: The puppy let out a yelp when I stepped on its tail.
ex.zh: 我踩到小狗尾巴時，牠發出一聲尖叫。

ex.en: We heard a sudden yelp from the next room.
ex.zh: 我們聽到隔壁房間傳來一聲突然的尖叫。

ex.en: The dog yelped in pain.
ex.zh: 那隻狗痛得尖叫。

ex.en: She yelped when the cold water hit her.
ex.zh: 冷水潑到她身上時，她尖叫了一聲。

ex.en: In old England, a yeoman owned and farmed his own small piece of land.
ex.zh: 在古代英格蘭，自耕農擁有並耕種自己的小塊土地。

ex.en: The yeoman worked hard from sunrise until night.
ex.zh: 那位自耕農從日出忙到夜晚。

ex.en: W. B. Yeats was an Irish poet who won the Nobel Prize in Literature.
ex.zh: 葉芝是愛爾蘭詩人，曾獲諾貝爾文學獎。

ex.en: We read a short poem by Yeats in class today.
ex.zh: 我們今天在課堂上讀了一首葉芝的短詩。

ex.en: The pages of the old book had yellowed with age.
ex.zh: 那本舊書的書頁隨著歲月而發黃。

ex.en: The leaves yellowed and fell in October.
ex.zh: 樹葉在十月轉黃後掉落。

ex.en: The old paper had turned yellowish.
ex.zh: 那張舊紙已經泛黃了。

ex.en: She has a yellowish scarf.
ex.zh: 她有一條偏黃的圍巾。

ex.en: The vote was 40 yeas and 10 nays.
ex.zh: 投票結果是四十票贊成、十票反對。

ex.en: Each yea counted toward passing the law.
ex.zh: 每一張贊成票都有助於讓法案通過。

ex.en: Yea, I think that is a great idea.
ex.zh: 是啊，我覺得這是個好主意。

ex.en: Yea or nay, you must decide today.
ex.zh: 不論贊成或反對，你今天都得決定。

ex.en: Yemeni coffee has been famous for hundreds of years.
ex.zh: 葉門咖啡已經有數百年的盛名。

ex.en: The museum has an exhibit of Yemeni art and crafts.
ex.zh: 博物館有一場葉門藝術與工藝品的展覽。

ex.en: A Yemeni shared stories about his hometown with us.
ex.zh: 一位葉門人跟我們分享了他家鄉的故事。

ex.en: Many Yemenis live in the coastal cities.
ex.zh: 許多葉門人住在沿海城市。

ex.en: The film brings back the style of yesteryear.
ex.zh: 這部電影帶回了昔日的風格。

ex.en: Stories of yesteryear are told in this small museum.
ex.zh: 這間小博物館講述著往昔的故事。

ex.en: The farmer sold a yearling at the spring market.
ex.zh: 農夫在春季市集賣了一匹一歲的小馬。

ex.en: A yearling is still growing and needs plenty of food.
ex.zh: 一歲的幼獸還在成長，需要很多食物。
